title: fix(deps): a fresh scaffold's tree carries no ts-morph — the CLI takes the compiler from typescript directly
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`@objectstack/cli` 不再依赖 `ts-morph`,改为直接依赖 `typescript` `^6.0.3`(与 `@objectstack/lint` 已声明的同一范围);CLI 只用到 `ts-morph` 转出的编译器命名空间,从未用它的项目 API。
- 为什么改:新建项目的依赖树里,`ts-morph → @ts-morph/common → minimatch` 10 这一支是我们自己的包可以去掉的;改后新脚手架的树不再含 `ts-morph`、`@ts-morph/common` 及其带入的 `minimatch` 10。
- 风险与回滚:低——同一条 TypeScript 6.0 线,命令、导出、行为不变;npm 安装的项目会多嵌套一份 `typescript@6.0.3`(净增约 9.9 MB 解包体积,pnpm 无增量反而净减);回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/cli/package.json`(依赖互换)、`packages/cli/src/utils/emitted-source-parses.ts`(懒加载改为取 `default`)、`packages/cli/test/published-subpath-hook-body.pin.test.ts`(tarball pin 改借 `typescript`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2 test/published-subpath-hook-body.pin.test.ts`,预期 15 个用例全过(打包后的 tarball 用 `typescript` 执行抽取器)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The rule: a fresh scaffold's tree carries no `ts-morph` and no `@ts-morph/common`, so none of the `minimatch` 10 line that `@ts-morph/common` 0.29.0 (its newest release, `minimatch ^10.0.1`) pulls in. The CLI takes the TypeScript compiler from `typescript` directly.

- `packages/cli/package.json`: `ts-morph` `^28.0.0` is dropped from `dependencies`; `typescript` `^6.0.3` moves from `devDependencies` to `dependencies`. That is the range `@objectstack/lint` (a CLI dependency) already declares at runtime, on the 6.0 line `ts-morph` 28 bundled (6.0.2).
- Six CLI modules took only the compiler namespace (`ts`) from `ts-morph`. They now import it from `typescript`: a static `import ts from 'typescript'` in `detect-free-identifiers.ts` and `extract-hook-body.ts`, and a lazy `const { default: ts } = await import('typescript')` in `emitted-source-parses.ts`, `importable-binding.ts`, `scaffold-wiring.ts` and `authored-source-codemod.ts`, which stay lazy for the reason their headers give. Type-only imports become `import type TS from 'typescript'`.
- Tests: four test files switch the same import. The `./hook-body` tarball pin now borrows `typescript` into its consumer and asserts that the manifest declares it under `dependencies`. `create-in-repo-scaffold-typechecks.test.ts` reads the CLI's own TypeScript range from `dependencies`, which is where it is declared now.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml`: `ts-morph@28.0.0`, `@ts-morph/common@0.29.0` and `code-block-writer@13.0.3` leave the lockfile. `osv-scanner.toml` and a `pnpm-workspace.yaml` comment stop listing `@ts-morph/common`/`ts-morph` as a `minimatch` parent, because the lockfile no longer has it.
- `.changeset/cli-compiler-from-typescript.md`: `@objectstack/cli` patch.

The other path a fresh scaffold had to the affected `glob` line, `@objectstack/metadata`, already carries the patched `glob` `^14.0.3` range on `main` (pending changeset `28292-glob-14-advisory`). This PR does not touch it.

## Tests

All run at `deaa7e45` unless a line says otherwise. Build and test seconds were measured under the shared verify lock on a shared box.

- `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/cli...`: 62/62 tasks, lock VERDICT command-exit 0 (`5b804323`; the later commit only changes a test file).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0 at `5b804323`. The run includes the test-layer check, `check:test-typecheck: OK`, with debt held at its pinned entries. The later commit's test file was re-run, as described below.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: 374/375 files and 5286/5287 tests passed at `5b804323`. The one red was `create-in-repo-scaffold-typechecks.test.ts`, which still read the CLI's TypeScript range from `devDependencies`. It was fixed in `deaa7e45` and re-run: 1/1 file, 5/5 tests. The `integration` tier is left to CI, because no integration-tier file or spawn entry changed.
- `create-objectstack`, the scaffold package: `typecheck` exit 0, and `vitest run` passed 23/23 files and 356/356 tests.
- Built `dist` executed on plain `node`, with no tsx and no vitest: `findEmissionParseFailures` flags `export const x = ;` and passes `export const y = 1;`. `findBarrelAliasRefusal('my-alias')` refuses and `findBarrelAliasRefusal('myAlias')` returns `null`. `barrelExportsBinding` answers `true` for an exported `a` and `false` for `b`, which appears only in a comment. The compiler resolved from the CLI is 6.0.3.
- One-time reverse verification of the retargeted tarball guard. The `typescript` line was deleted from `packages/cli/package.json` (anchor count 1 to 0, blob `9c7c8f4a630c` to `9cd3a889c435`). The pin then failed on `@objectstack/cli must declare typescript in "dependencies"`. Restored: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The first attempt was a no-op that the helper refused before any test ran, because its replacement text was a substring of the anchor.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not closed here (no producer fix exists today):** two other paths in a fresh scaffold's tree still resolve `minimatch` below 11.
  - `@oclif/core` 5.1.11, its newest release, declares `^10.2.5`.
  - `exceljs` 4.4.0 (`@objectstack/rest`'s xlsx import/export, also its newest release) reaches `minimatch` through `archiver` 5 and `unzipper` 0.10.
  - Even `archiver` 8.0.0's `readdir-glob` 3.0.0 declares `minimatch ^10.2.2`.
  - The only patched `minimatch` is 11, which removes `makeRe` and `AST` and changes the parsed-pattern form that `glob` 7 reads. No published parent accepts it yet, the same reading the `osv-scanner.toml` entry records for this workspace. So a cross-major scaffold `overrides` entry was **not** added.
- **Declined: an `npm audit` check in the scaffold smoke.** Not added. New gates are "no" by default, and the only exception is a maintainer naming one (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, and `references/instrument-discipline.md`). No such naming exists here.
- **Install footprint:** a project whose root `typescript` is the scaffold's `^5.3.0` gets one more nested `typescript@6.0.3` under `@objectstack/cli` from npm. `@objectstack/lint`'s copy is nested beside it, and npm cannot share sibling-nested copies. That copy is 24.3 MB unpacked. It replaces `ts-morph` (1.5 MB), `@ts-morph/common` (12.8 MB, which bundled its own compiler), `code-block-writer` and `path-browserify`, for a net of about +9.9 MB on npm. pnpm stores one copy, so the net there is about -14.4 MB.
- `osv-scanner.toml`: the existing `minimatch` entry keeps its id, scope and `ignoreUntil`. Its reason only drops `@ts-morph/common`, a parent that is no longer in the lockfile. That is not an addition or a renewal, so it may ride with the fix under the file's convention 3.
- `main` moved 14 commits since the base `06881565`. None of them touch a path in this diff, so the branch was not merged.
- No API, command, export or behaviour change. Type-only imports change their spelling, not their shape.

## Verification

Simulated next-release scaffold: the blank template's manifest, with every reachable `@objectstack/*` package (60) replaced by its current workspace manifest. npm 10.9.9, `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --install-links`, then `npm ls`.
